demo.program:
# SQL — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created SQL?", "IBM (Chamberlin & Boyce)"),
    ("What paradigm is SQL?", "declarative"),
    ("What is creator?", "IBM (Chamberlin & Boyce)"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1974"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "declarative"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".sql"),
    ("What is hello world?", "SELECT 'Hello, world!';"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
